output.headline: Pays F3 and Associates up to $148,995 for land surveys at six schools
output.summary: F3 and Associates will do land surveys at six schools, including ground surveys, underground utility location using ground-penetrating radar, boundary checks and a survey after construction. The surveys support soil sampling and environmental assessment projects. The amount includes $13,545 held back for extra services the district may request, and work runs from January 29 to March 30, 2026.

output.headline: Accepts a free after-school bike club for newcomer students at Oakland International High School
output.summary: Cycles of Change, an Oakland group, will run a bike club for newcomer students after school. The club builds fitness, safe biking skills and teamwork, and gives students a place to practice English. It runs from November 1, 2025 to June 30, 2026 at no cost to the district, and the board is approving it after it started.

output.headline: Extends Asbestos Management Group's demolition contract at Ralph Bunche and Hillside to June 30, 2026
output.summary: This change order gives Asbestos Management Group 181 more calendar days, to June 30, 2026, to finish demolition at the Ralph Bunche and Hillside school sites. The work was paused so another contractor could do priority hazardous waste cleanup after a fire. No added money is stated.

output.headline: Cuts $630,986.67 from Syserco's CAL Shape building contract after removing plumbing work
output.summary: This change order lowers the contract with Syserco Energy Solutions from $11,720,359.50 to $11,089,372.83 by giving the district a credit for plumbing work that was removed. It also shortens the contract by 27 calendar days. The work covers McClymonds High School, Roosevelt Middle School, Ralph Bunche High School and Gateway to Laney College Campus.

output.headline: Sets up The KDI Group, Inc. as an on-call school construction inspector at no upfront cost
output.summary: This is a master agreement that lets The KDI Group, Inc. provide state-certified Inspector of Record services at district school construction projects. It has a $0 limit because no work is guaranteed; future project assignments will come back to the board separately. It starts January 29, 2026 and ends when all assigned projects are complete.

output.headline: Pays Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf up to $463,244 to replace the turf at Calvin Simmons Middle School
output.summary: Shaw Sports Synthetic Turf will remove the existing turf and install a new turf system at Calvin Simmons Middle School. The amount includes $42,113 for contingencies. The district is buying through a state contract, the California Multiple Award Schedules (CMAS), instead of running its own bid. Work runs from January 29, 2026 to January 29, 2027.

output.headline: Accepts free Living Jazz music program at La Escuelita Elementary School
output.summary: Living Jazz, an Oakland group, will lead a music program at La Escuelita Elementary School to build creativity, confidence, self-expression, collaboration and empathy. It runs from December 1, 2025 to May 28, 2026 at no cost to the district.

output.headline: Ratifies a new member of the Measures N and H college and career commission
output.summary: The board is ratifying the Board President's appointment of Tony Douangviseth, in a first term, to the Measures N and H - College and Career Readiness Commission. The term runs from February 1, 2026 to January 31, 2028.

output.headline: Approves the quarterly report on Williams Uniform Complaints for July 2025 to January 2026
output.summary: The board is approving the General Counsel's quarterly reports on Williams Uniform Complaints for July 2025, October 2025 and January 2026. The text does not describe the complaints in the reports or any cost.

output.headline: Approves minutes of the January 14, 2026 regular Board of Education meeting
output.summary: The board is approving the written minutes of its regular meeting on January 14, 2026. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting.

output.headline: Approves minutes of the January 20, 2026 special Board of Education meeting
output.summary: The board is approving the written minutes of its special meeting on January 20, 2026. Staff prepared the minutes shortly after the meeting.

output.headline: Revises the job description for the College & Career Readiness for All program manager
output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2526-0070 to revise the job description for the Program Manager of the College & Career Readiness for All Initiative in High School Linked Learning. The text does not say what changed in the description or whether it costs anything.

output.headline: Adopts a resolution certifying unhoused pupils for charter school facilities funding applications
output.summary: The board is adopting Resolution No. 2526-0011, which certifies unhoused pupils as it relates to charter school applications for facilities funding. The text does not give a dollar amount.
